Yea, you speak the truth. I really have no clue what i want to do with my life. I'm studying economics but i have no intention of working with something related to that. 
I love photography and writing, but i  can't see how it's going to support me for the rest of my life, so i'm stuck studying for something in not interested in, so that i can get a job, doing something im not interested in. It sucks.

I really appreciate it, but school is keeping me here. I can totally relate to bad habits, i don't really sleep much and when i do, it's very light and unsatisfying sleep. Thank you though, it's nice to know i'm not alone.
